sn35.89:1.1: atha kho āyasmā bāhiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā bāhiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.89:1.2: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn35.89:4.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.89:6.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn35.89:6.2: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn35.89:9.4: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti.
sn35.89:11.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.89:13.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn35.89:13.2: etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti.
sn35.89:15.1: evaṃ passaṃ bāhiya sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati …pe…
sn35.89:15.2: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn35.89:15.3: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.89:15.4: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
sn35.89:16.1: atha kho āyasmā bāhiyo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn35.89:16.2: atha kho āyasmā bāhiyo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
sn35.89:16.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn35.89:16.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā bāhiyo arahataṃ ahosīti.
